name: Vale
source:
"Ah, my executioner has arrived."

In an underground prison cell beneath the Empire's royal palace, a girl chats with her executioner. What kind of future awaits these two?

[From [url=https://abyss-team.itch.io/vale]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“啊，我的刽子手来了。”

在帝国皇宫下方的地下牢房中，一名女孩正在与刽子手聊天。等待着两人的将会是怎样的未来呢？

[来自[url=https://abyss-team.itch.io/vale]Itch.io[/url]]
